title: (RHBA-2017:2532) DevSuite 2.0.0-2 release
portal_summary: Red Hat Development Suite 2.0.0-2 has been released.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Developer Tools|Red Hat Developer Tools (for RHEL Server)|1|x86_64
Red Hat Developer Tools|Red Hat Developer Tools (for RHEL Workstation)|1|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat Development Suite integrates a number of development tools, including Red Hat JBoss Developer Studio, Red Hat Container Development Kit, and Kompose. The DevSuite installer streamlines the installation and integration of all the components, so that the user can immediately start developing using all these tools.

Prior to this update, the rh-devsuite package (version 2.0.0-1) had a dependency on a non-existent package, rh-eclipse46, which caused the installation of DevSuite to fail. The incorrect dependency has been fixed to require the rh-eclipse47 package, and the installation no longer fails. (BZ#1481921)

Users of rh-devsuite are advised to upgrade to this updated package.
